s=open('/tmp/r28rev/c28.sh').read(); print(s[:200]); import re; print(re.findall(r'argv[^\n]*',s))
import json
calls=[]
for line in open('/root/worktrees/dealroom-sign-edd/docs/edd/briefs/counterparty-c2a-gate3-r29.jsonl'):
    try: d=json.loads(line)
    except: continue
    m=d.get('message') if isinstance(d,dict) else None
    c=m.get('content') if isinstance(m,dict) else None
    if isinstance(c,list):
        for b in c:
            if isinstance(b,dict) and b.get('type')=='tool_use': calls.append(b)
for i,b in enumerate(calls):
    cmd=b['input'].get('command','')
    if 'c28' in cmd: print(i, cmd[:400])
